# Member date picker assets

The reference member editor uses Eonasdan Bootstrap datetimepicker. The JavaScript was retrieved from its publicly served asset at `https://ad.leadink.cn/assets/libs/eonasdan-bootstrap-datetimepicker/build/js/bootstrap-datetimepicker.min.js`.

CSS and license: `eonasdan-bootstrap-datetimepicker@4.17.47` from jsDelivr. Chinese Moment locale: `moment@2.30.1/locale/zh-cn.js` from jsDelivr; Moment's license is in `moment-LICENSE`.

All assets are served locally. The member editor uses `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss`, `zh-cn`, `useCurrent: true`, and FontAwesome icons. Read-only reference evidence is in `visual-baseline/reference-verified/member-date-picker.json`.
